primary_panel: Same site, January or July, and ordinal complete UTC week in both years
service_metric: Energy deficit beyond the deficit from immediate charging, divided by original requested energy
retained_service: For each session, deliver at least the energy achievable by immediate charging at the early checkpoint; deliver all recorded energy by the proxy session end
power_sensitivity: Apply 11 and 22 kW vehicle ceilings to the same sessions individually feasible at 11 kW, with capacities frozen from 2023
grid_sensitivity: Cap each site's half-hour grid imports at the grid-only immediate-charging peak in its own week
